name: Manhattan Veterinary Group
notes: A general veterinary practice (part of VCA) at 240 East 80th Street, between 2nd and 3rd Avenues. It is not an emergency hospital and is not open overnight; for an emergency out of hours, go to a 24-hour hospital such as VEG Upper East Side or the Animal Medical Center.

change_log.note: Read on VCA's own page for this hospital, in a browser: 240 East 80th Street, 212-988-1000, regular hours Mon-Fri 9:00 am-7:00 pm, Sat 9:00 am-5:00 pm. The research had it as "Open 24h", which was wrong, and it is not on the Mayor's Alliance emergency list. Phone and address match. Taken off the emergency-vet listings because it is a general practice.
